name: Automotive headlight production line solution
summary: Turnkey automated production line solutions for automotive headlamp manufacturers, covering lens assembly, reflector installation, LED module assembly, and final packaging.
contentHtml:
The headlamp production line solution is a turnkey automated solution provided by TXAM for automotive headlamp manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The complete line covers the entire process including lens assembly, reflector installation, LED module assembly, photometric testing, sealant application, air-tightness testing, appearance inspection, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision optical assembly ensures lighting performance
  • Accurate LED module positioning for consistent light patterns
  • Sealant application system for reliable sealing performance
  • Sensitive air-tightness testing to ensure zero leakage
  • Automated photometric testing for high pass rates
  • Rapid multi-model changeover to meet market demands

Services

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, to after-sales service.
